@s1 stated
  relation "have together a deposit at"
  role subject "the user's mother and the user's father"
  role object "CEC Bank"
  role location "CEC Bank"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s2 stated
  relation "be in the name of"
  role subject "the deposit"
  role object "both of them"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@s3 stated
  relation "have amount"
  role subject "the deposit"
  role object "38.000 lei"
  polarity affirmed
  certainty asserted

@q query
  where match
    relation "be blocked"
    role subject "the deposit"
    polarity affirmed
  end

@a1 assumed
  relation "refer to"
  role subject "one of them"
  role object "one of the user's parents"
  polarity affirmed
  basis disambiguation

@a2 assumed
  relation "die"
  role subject ?p
  polarity affirmed
  basis implicature
